title: Thoracic segmental axial rotation T1-T2 to T12-L1 in maximal trunk rotation (supine CT)
condition: healthy, supine, pelvis fixed, active maximal trunk rotation (one side, from neutral)

quantity.name: segmental axial rotation ROM
quantity.definition: rotation about the local z (longitudinal) axis of each vertebra relative to the inferior adjacent vertebra, neutral to maximal trunk rotation on one side (SRS axes, Euler X-Y-Z); mean of right and left sides

source.authors: Fujimori T, Iwasaki M, Nagamoto Y, Ishii T, Kashii M, Murase T, Sugiura T, Matsuo Y, Sugamoto K, Yoshikawa H
source.sample: 13 healthy male volunteers, not athletes/gymnasts, no spinal disorder/surgery/lung disease, scoliosis <5 deg (13 of the 15 men later used in Fujimori 2014 lateral-bending study)

protocol.summary: CT in neutral and right/left maximal supine trunk rotation with the pelvis belted; segmental Euler angles by voxel registration (accuracy 0.13 deg in AR).
how_to_use: For a thoracic axial rotation of theta (T1 relative to L1, max one side 24.9 deg), distribute it per level in proportion to the per-level shares (derived rows; sum of segmental means 21.4 deg): upper T1-T6 ~32%, middle T6-T11 ~51%, lower T11-L1 ~8%.
Peak segmental AR at T8-T11 (2.5-2.7 deg); T12-L1 only 0.5 deg (sagittal thoracolumbar facets).
Add the coupled motions from kinematics.fujimori2012.ar_coupled_motion when imposing rotation (same-direction coupled LB in the upper thoracic spine).
Supine with pelvis fixed and no gravity load; standing or seated rotation (e.g. Narimani 2018, Edmondston 2007) can be larger, scale the total but keep the distribution.

measurement.device: low-dose CT (GE LightSpeed), 0.625 mm slices, pixel 0.352 mm; voxel-based registration of each vertebra, Euler angles roll (X) - pitch (Y) - yaw (Z) relative to the inferior vertebra, SRS local axes
measurement.posture: supine, arms behind head, pelvis belted to the table (ASIS parallel), head kept neutral, cushions supporting the rotated trunk
measurement.task: active maximal trunk rotation (shoulder girdle along the trunk axis) to right and left within comfort (no defined moment)

protocol.notes: Segmental Euler angles are not additive: sum of segmental means 23.4 deg vs T1-L1 24.9 deg. Right and left sides were pooled ('to 1 side'); no side-specific table.
